services.desc: Experience Chattanooga’s Great Adventure! 1 Hour About The Ultimate Chattanooga Experience: The Chattanooga Ducks 1-Hour Narrated Tour If you're visiting Chattanooga, there’s one experience you absolutely can’t miss—and that’s the Chattanooga Ducks tour! This isn’t just a tour; it’s the must-do adventure that brings the best of the city’s land and water together in a way you’ve never imagined. Climb aboard an authentic, fully renovated WWII amphibious landing craft and prepare for a thrilling ride through downtown Chattanooga and the stunning Tennessee River.
